responseMessageContents.text:
Got it! So your vision is for the **mountain detail screen** (`mountain/[id].tsx`) — when you tap into a specific mountain:

1. **Background imagery** — The mountain's image/illustration would be superimposed as the background of the detail screen, creating an immersive feel (think a hero image that bleeds behind the content, maybe with a gradient overlay so text remains readable).

2. **Tappable icon** — The mountain icon/silhouette on the detail screen would be interactive. Tapping it could open a larger visual of the mountain — like a full-screen modal or lightbox showing the mountain imagery in detail.

This would give each mountain its own visual identity and make the detail screen feel much more alive compared to a plain card-based layout. It's a great approach — similar to how travel apps like AllTrails or national park apps handle landmark pages.

Want me to mock this up visually before building it?
